One record for the whole weight column (keyed on rs6859 because the tool has no column scope). Ordinal curator scale declared in weighting:. Weights withheld where a kept SNP lies within 500 kb of another kept SNP with a smaller longevity P, because independence for longevity is not established (lead SNPs were clumped on mvARD, not longevity). [jmc field=weight value_sha256=3949db624334 source=curator recorded=2026-11-26T05:51:47Z by=claude-opus-5-5]

Kept every mvARD lead SNP whose extreme-longevity P in Supplementary Table S9 is below 0.05; tiered significant at P < 0.05/263 (6 SNPs) and suggestive otherwise. Direction, state and effect size come from the ST9 longevity BETA re-signed to the less common allele in gnomAD v4.1 non-Finnish Europeans; mvARD beta used only in prose. Rows generated by script from the workbook cells, not retyped. Alternatives not taken: the 6 Bonferroni SNPs only, or all 263.
